# ankra_ai_ticket_project_channels (Resource)

The Slack channel and Microsoft Teams conversation one project's AI board threads go to instead of the organisation's (`ankra tickets settings projects set`). Set at least one. Destroy sends the project's threads back to the organisation's channels. Needs an organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_ticket_project_channels" "payments" {
  project_id       = ankra_project.payments.id
  slack_channel_id = "C0987654321"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `slack_channel_id` (String) Slack channel the project's board threads go to.
- `teams_conversation_id` (String) Microsoft Teams conversation the project's board threads go to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by project id.
terraform import ankra_ai_ticket_project_channels.payments 5d1c2b3a-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
```
